title: Brownian Bridge Diffusion-Assisted Joint Channel Estimation and Data Detection for Jamming-Resilient OFDM Receivers
abstract: arXiv:2606.28778v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In next-generation wireless networks, the growing density of devices and limited spectrum resources pose severe jamming challenges to fragile legitimate communication links in the wireless electromagnetic environment. Crucially, when jamming overlaps with pilot and data symbols in both time and frequency domains, it inflicts a severe bottleneck on receiver-side joint estimation and detection. Existing schemes often lack an effective framework to combat such jamming contamination, thereby failing to guarantee reliable transmission. To address this issue, we propose a Brownian bridge diffusion-assisted joint channel estimation and data detection (BBD-JCED) framework for jamming-resilient orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) receivers. translated_title: 面向抗干扰OFDM接收机的布朗桥扩散辅助联合信道估计与数据检测
translated_abstract: 在下一代无线网络中，设备密度的不断增长和频谱资源的有限性，对无线电磁环境中脆弱的合法通信链路构成了严重的干扰挑战。关键的是，当干扰在时域和频域上都与导频和数据符号重叠时，会给接收端的联合估计与检测带来严重瓶颈。现有方案往往缺乏有效的框架来对抗此类干扰污染，因而无法保证可靠传输。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种面向抗干扰正交频分复用（OFDM）接收机的布朗桥扩散辅助联合信道估计与数据检测（BBD-JCED）框架。所提出的框架由干扰抑制模块和布朗桥联合恢复模块组成。前者在短时傅里叶变换域中识别受干扰污染的频点……
tldr: 该论文提出了布朗桥扩散辅助的联合信道估计与数据检测（BBD-JCED）框架，通过干扰抑制模块与布朗桥联合恢复模块，使OFDM接收机在时频域干扰与导频及数据符号重叠的情况下仍能实现可靠传输。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Brownian bridge diffusion-assisted joint channel estimation and data detection (BBD-JCED) framework, which combines a jamming suppression module and a Brownian bridge joint recovery module to enable jamming-resilient OFDM receivers to achieve reliable transmission even when jamming overlaps with pilot and data symbols in both time and frequency domains.
